rows.en: “Sometimes Touko dies by chance, or Shima, or Mimi...”

ghs.en: Miki: "Then, randomly, Touko-senpai might die, Shima-senpai might die, Mimi-senpai might die... all those can happen!"
Miki: "That is what happened this time."

rows.jp: 「犯人は……罠を仕掛けた最初の一件をのぞけば……偶然だってのか？」
rows.en: “Except for the first incident, which started with your trap... you're saying chance killed everyone?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "The culprit... aside from the traps that caught the first one... was coincidence?"

rows.jp: 「偶然は、たまに見えない殺人者になります」

ghs.en: Miki: "Coincidence, occasionally, becomes an invisible murderer."

rows.jp: 「ループ世界では、たまに、というのは確定された出来事なんですよ」

ghs.en: Miki: "In the Loop World, this 'occasionally' is more of a determined event."
Taichi: "But Touko's been stabbed, wasn't she?"

rows.jp: 「冬子先輩は、毎回高確率で餓死するんですよ」
rows.en: “Touko has a very high chance of starving to death in any given loop.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Touko-senpai has a high likelihood of starving to death every time."

rows.jp: 「で、今回はもう死んでいたんで、死体に短剣刺しときました」
rows.en: “This time she was already dead, so I stuck a dagger in her body.”

ghs.en: Miki: "And, as she was already dead on this time, I stabbed her cadaver with a dagger."

rows.jp: 「……霧ちんのスイッチが入るように」
「霧ちんが先輩を殺そうとするように」
rows.en: “To make her try to kill you.”

ghs.en: Miki: "To make Kiri-chin try to kill you, Senpai."

rows.jp: 「あ、先輩が嫌いなんじゃないんですよ？」
rows.en: “Oh, it's not that I hate you.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Ah, I don't dislike you, Senpai, you know?"
Miki: "Just... it's because you are dangerous."

rows.jp: 「あなたも高確率で、暴走するじゃないですか」
rows.en: “You lose control pretty often too, don't you?”

ghs.en: Miki: "Don't you have also a high probability of going rampant?"

rows.jp: 「血を見ると、よくおかしくなりますよね？」
rows.en: “Blood often sends you off the deep end, doesn't it?”

ghs.en: Miki: "When you see blood, don't you often become odd?"

rows.jp: 「今まではなんとかやりくりして、安定させてきたつもりです」
rows.en: “Until now, I thought I'd somehow managed to keep everything stable.”

ghs.en: Miki: "All until now was to somehow manage this, and to attempt to stabilize things."

rows.jp: 「……はは、俺のおもりしてくれたんだ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "...hahah, you've been babysitting me then!"

rows.jp: 「優しいときの先輩は、大好きだから」
rows.en: “Because I love you when you're kind.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Because I really like you when you're nice, Senpai."

rows.jp: 感情が宿ったのは一瞬。
rows.en: Emotion surfaced for a single instant.

ghs.en: Emotion took dwelling in her for one instant.

rows.jp: 「……でも、今回は支倉先輩が死ぬというイレギュラーが発生しました」
rows.en: “...But this time, something irregular happened: Hasekura died.”

ghs.en: Miki: "...but, this time we had the irregular complication of Hasekura-senpai's death."

rows.jp: 「あの人、ほとんど人間離れしてますんで、わたしのキャンプもよく見つかります」
rows.en: “She's almost superhuman, so she often finds my camp.”

ghs.en: Miki: "That person is practically superhuman, so she often discovers my camp."

rows.jp: 「キャンプって祠のそばにあるの？」

ghs.en: Taichi: "You have a camp, you mean next to the hokora?"

rows.jp: 「はい。合宿の荷物、借りまして……あ、動かないでください」
rows.en: “Yes. I borrowed the gear from our training camp... Oh, please don't move.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Yes. I borrowed it from the training camp's equipment... ah, don't move, please."

rows.jp: 「ごめんなさい……それは許可できないです……」

ghs.en: Miki: "Apologies... that's something I can't allow..."

rows.jp: 「……はぁ……なんつうか、またその話が本当ならまた生き返るんだろうけど」
rows.en: “...Well... if what you said is true, I suppose I'll come back to life anyway.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...sigh... why even, because if that thing you said's true then I'll just be reborn again."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese filler means 'how should I put it' or 'well,' not a question asking why.
ghs.remedy: how should I put this

highlights.text: why even

rows.jp: 「支倉先輩なんですけど、見つかったときはすぐ降伏してるんですよ。情報提供だけして」
rows.en: “When Hasekura finds me, I surrender right away. I just give her information.”

ghs.en: Miki: "When Hasekura-senpai discovers me, I immediately surrender. I just provide information."

rows.jp: 「やっても勝てっこないですからね」
rows.en: “I wouldn’t stand a chance against her.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Because whatever I do, I could never beat her, you know."

rows.en: “You really look out for number one.”

rows.jp: 「支倉先輩がいなくなった時の、あなたの反応は未知のものでした」
rows.en: “Your reaction to Hasekura's disappearance was an unknown variable.”

ghs.en: Miki: "How you'd react in case of Hasekura-senpai being no more was something unknown."

rows.jp: 「……霧ちんが悪意ノイローゼになったのもありますけど、あっという間にキレかけてましたよね？」
rows.en: “...Kiri-kins had already cracked under all the malice, but you started losing it almost immediately too, didn't you?”

ghs.en: Miki: "...Kiri-chin can also end up being neurotically malicious, did you see how she just snapped in the blink of an eye?"
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says Kiri developed a neurosis or fixation concerning others' malice. The English instead describes Kiri herself as malicious.
ghs.remedy: Kiri-chin also became neurotic about people's malice

highlights.text: can also end up being neurotically malicious

rows.jp: 「おっしゃる通り……自分が大事なんです、すごく」
rows.en: “You were right... I care about myself. A great deal.”

ghs.en: Miki: "As those words say... I am very important to myself, very much."

rows.jp: 「それがキミの群青色ってわけだ」
rows.en: “So that's your shade of Gunjo blue.”
“...Yes. I suppose that's what it comes down to.”

rows.jp: 「人の痛みとか全然わからないので」
rows.en: “I don't understand anyone else's pain at all.”

ghs.en: Miki: "I just don't get people's pain or anything of the sort at all, so,"

rows.jp: 「人のフリだけして生きてるようなものです」
rows.en: “I live as if I'm only pretending to be a person.”

ghs.en: Miki: "I'm just something that lives on pretending to be a person."

rows.jp: 「これ、霧ちんがいつだか先輩を責めるときに使った言葉です」
rows.en: “Those are words Kiri-kins once used to accuse you.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Those are the words that Kiri-chin sometimes uses when she wants to torment you, Senpai."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese refers to words Kiri used on one unspecified occasion when accusing or reproaching him. The English changes that to a recurring habit and strengthens reproach into torment.
ghs.remedy: used once when she was accusing you

highlights.text: sometimes uses when she wants to torment you

rows.jp: 「あ、そういう展開になったことがあるですよ」
rows.en: “Oh. There was one version of the week where that happened.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Ah, when things have unfolded that way, of course."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says there was a loop in which events unfolded that way. The English makes it a conditional-like fragment and adds 'of course.'
ghs.remedy: There was a time things unfolded that way.

highlights.text: when things have unfolded that way, of course

rows.jp: 「ああ、リセットされる前の俺ね」
rows.en: “Ah. The me from before a reset.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Ahhh, it was to a me before the reset, you mean."

rows.jp: 「先輩は擬態してるわけじゃないですよね」
rows.en: “You aren't pretending to be human, though.”

rows.jp: 「ただ……人であろうとしているだけですよね」

ghs.en: Miki: "You're just... trying to be a human."

rows.jp: 「で、本当に擬態して寄生しているのは……わたしだったりするんです」
rows.en: “Maybe I'm the one really wearing a human disguise and living like a parasite.”

ghs.en: Miki: "And, the one who was really a camouflaged parasite... was me."

rows.jp: 「……ずっと祠に隠れてるってのはダメなの？」
rows.en: “...Can’t you simply stay hidden in the shrine?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...it a problem if you were to just always hide yourself in the hokora?"

rows.jp: 「退屈で、気が狂いそうになりますよ？」

ghs.en: Miki: "I would just lose my mind from boredom, wouldn't I?"

rows.jp: 「適度にみんなの精神状態保って、支倉先輩と交渉して、気をつかって……そういうことを延々と繰り返すわけですよ」
rows.en: “I keep everyone more or less sane, negotiate with Hasekura, watch my step... and repeat the same things forever.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Preserving everyone in a suitable state of mind, negotiating with Hasekura-senpai, paying attention... those are all the things that I endlessly repeat."

rows.jp: 「でも、そんなことをしている時は、ただ無邪気なままの自分でいられて……先輩とばかやったり……みんなと部活したり……」
rows.en: “But while I'm doing all that, I get to be innocent... goof off with you... spend time at the club with everyone...”

ghs.en: Miki: "But, while I'm doing all that, I must be the normal innocent myself... playing the fool with Senpai... doing club activities with everyone..."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says those activities let her remain her ordinary innocent self. The English changes that enabling relation into an obligation.
ghs.remedy: I can just remain my usual innocent self

highlights.text: I must be the normal innocent myself

rows.jp: 「……祠にいると、主観的な時間は保護されるとして……いつか美希が大人になったら？」
rows.en: “...If the shrine protects your subjective time... what happens when you grow older?”

ghs.en: Taichi: "...when you are in the hokora, your subjective time is preserved, but... won't you become an adult someday, Miki, and what then?"

rows.jp: 「いつかは無理が来るので、リセットをかけないといけないんでしょうけど」
rows.en: “Eventually I won't be able to keep it up, and I'll have to let the reset take me.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Someday will come when it'll be impossible, that I'll just have to take a reset, but..."

rows.jp: 「それはもう……今のわたしとは違う人ですから……」
rows.en: “But then... I'll be somebody different from who I am now...”

ghs.en: Miki: "That's already... because I, as I am now, am already a different person..."
ghs.assessment: The Japanese says the person after a future reset would no longer be the present her. The English says the present self is already a different person, reversing the temporal comparison.
ghs.remedy: because whoever comes after that won't be the me I am now

highlights.text: because I, as I am now, am already a different person

rows.jp: 「自分がなくなるのは、こわい」

ghs.en: Miki: "That my self would disappear... it's scary."

rows.jp: 「こんな誰もいない世界で、なくなってしまうのはこわい」
rows.en: “I'm afraid of disappearing from a world where no one is left.”

ghs.en: Miki: "Vanishing from this world where there is no one makes me scared."

rows.jp: 「わたし、なぜかひとりぼっちみたいな気がして」
rows.en: “I don't know why, but I feel completely alone.”

ghs.en: Miki: "For some reason, I feel a sort of solitude."

rows.jp: 「なんだか、虚しくなってきたんです」

ghs.en: Miki: "As if somehow it was all hollow."

rows.jp: 「今先輩と話して、さらに虚しくなっちゃいました」
rows.en: “Talking to you now has made it feel even emptier.”

ghs.en: Miki: "And by talking to you now, Senpai, it's all become even more hollow."

rows.jp: 「うむ。校長クラスの長話っぷりだったからな」
rows.en: “Well, you gave a speech worthy of a school principal.”

ghs.en: Taichi: "Yeah. 'Cause that was one Headmaster Class of a long talk."
Taichi: "It was a really interesting chat."

rows.jp: 「……あはは……やっぱ、先輩はわたしよりすごい人ですね」
rows.en: “...Ahaha... You really are even more amazing than I am.”

ghs.en: Miki: "...ahahah... of course, you're a much more amazing person than me, Senpai."

rows.jp: 「曜子ちゃんとかもっと別物だぞ」

ghs.en: Taichi: "But Youko-chan, to say, she's way something else."

rows.jp: 「あの人は……完璧に近いものではありますけど……まとまっただけの人間そのものじゃないですか」
rows.en: “She may be close to perfect... but she's still just a remarkably well-put-together human being, isn't she?”

ghs.en: Miki: "That person's... she's something close to completeness, yet... she's just not a congruous human in the literal sense of the word, isn't she?"
ghs.assessment: The Japanese characterizes her as nearly perfect but still simply a well-integrated human being. The English negates her being a coherent human and substantially reverses the claim.
ghs.remedy: she's close to perfect, but isn't she still just a thoroughly put-together human being?

highlights.text: she's just not a congruous human in the literal sense of the word

rows.jp: 「わたしと同じで、わたしより重いのに、わたしの何倍も頑張ってる」
rows.en: “You're like me, except your burden is heavier—and you still try so much harder.”

ghs.en: Miki: "You're the same as me, and even if you have it far worse than I, you make many times my effort."

rows.jp: 「わたしがはじめて、好きになれた人なんです、あなたは」
rows.en: “You're the first person I've ever been able to love.”

ghs.en: Miki: "The very first person that I... fell in love with, was you."

rows.en: So she could kill me more easily.
